messages:
amir.j: Hi all  I have a religious holiday (observed Tue Dec 26) that conflicts with our company-observed holiday on Mon Dec 25. I want to swap the company holiday and take PTO on Dec 25 instead, then have Dec 26 treated as the paid holiday for me. Is that allowed?
hr-bot: Policy highlight: holiday swaps for religious observance are permitted with manager approval and People Ops notification. Swaps do not create additional paid time off. See: https://redwood.company/policies/holidays
sarah_mgr: I can approve the swap. My ask is that Amir files the PTO for Dec 25 in Lattice and adds a note "religious holiday swap requested/approved" so we have the audit trail.
olivia-peopleops: Quick clarifications: 1) We can mark Dec 26 as the paid holiday for Amir and exempt Dec 25 from being a paid company holiday for him, 2) This does not affect carryover rules  if the employee uses PTO Dec 25 and that causes them to exceed carryover cap at year-end, standard carryover caps and encashment options apply.
tom.payroll: Operational note: to ensure payroll picks up the swapped holiday correctly please add a Lattice comment and tag People Ops by Dec 18 (payroll cutoff). If we get it after cutoff we can still fix via manual adjustment but it becomes an off-cycle change.
amir.j: Thanks  I submitted PTO for Dec 25 and added the note you asked for. Sarah approved.
olivia-peopleops: Got it. Two small items: 1) Sarah please add a manager approval note with the exact text "Holiday swap approved for religious observance; treat 12/26 as paid holiday, employee to use PTO 12/25" and 2) Amir please confirm you do not want carryover offered for that PTO hour (i.e., prefer to use PTO now vs encashment).
sarah_mgr: Note added in Lattice. Text: "Holiday swap approved for religious observance; treat 12/26 as paid holiday, employee to use PTO 12/25. Manager: Sarah."
amir.j: I confirm I want to use PTO now, not encashment. Also FYI I have 36h carried from last year already, so no cap issues expected but wanted to be explicit.
olivia-peopleops: Perfect. We'll tag this for year-end processing so payroll applies the holiday swap and preserves carryover math. We'll create an internal ticket to reconcile if anything shows up after payroll runs.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-9055  olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-9055
tom.payroll: I'll watch for the tag and run the swap during the Dec payroll cycle. If we need to do an off-cycle fix I'll flag Amir and Sarah before taking action.
amir.j: Appreciate the help  thanks everyone. Closing loop once payroll confirms.
olivia-peopleops: We'll confirm here after payroll runs. :thumbsup:
